hero.label: Contact
hero.title: Say Hello
hero.lead: Pick the right channel for what you have in mind.

hi.label: Just saying hi?
hi.body: Drop a quick hello or ask any question — I'm always happy to hear from you. Slide into my DMs on Twitter or Instagram.

work.label: Want to work on something together?
work.body: I've worked with several startups and I do entrepreneurship myself — so I know the difference between a bare idea and a real project. If you have more than just a concept and a solid deal to offer, write me directly.

job.label: Job offer or career advice?
job.body: LinkedIn is the right place for professional conversations. Write me directly there.

langNote.text: I write in Spanish on <twitter>Twitter</twitter>. If you'd rather follow me in English, you'll find me on <bluesky>Bluesky</bluesky>, <threads>Threads</threads>, or <mastodon>Mastodon</mastodon>.
